cards.ex: I need to commit these dates to memory before the exam.
cards.exUz: Imtihondan oldin bu sanalarni yodlab olishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Nimani to'liq yodlash, esda saqlash uchun harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: I had a total mental block during the interview and couldn't answer the simplest questions.
cards.exUz: Suhbatda ruhiy to'siqqa duch keldim va eng oddiy savollarga javob bera olmadim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani eslay olmaslik, o'ylay olmaslik holati.

cards.ex: Her state of mind was fragile after the accident.
cards.exUz: Baxtsiz hodisadan keyin uning ruhiy holati nozik edi.
cards.uzDef: Odamning o'sha paytdagi hissiy va psixologik holati.

cards.ex: I had a brainwave in the shower about how to solve the problem.
cards.exUz: Dushda muammoni qanday hal qilish haqida aqlga kelgan fikrga ega bo'ldim.
cards.uzDef: To'satdan kelgan ajoyib g'oya yoki fikr.

cards.ex: The stress of the job started to take its toll on her memory.
cards.exUz: Ishdagi stress uning xotirasiga ta'sir qila boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq davom etgan stressning aqliy yoki jismoniy sog'liqqa salbiy ta'siri.

cards.ex: Going through old photos is like taking a trip down memory lane.
cards.exUz: Eski suratlarni ko'rib chiqish xotiralar olamiga sayohat qilishga o'xshaydi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishni eslash, xotiralarga berilish.

cards.ex: My mind wanders during long meetings, and I miss important details.
cards.exUz: Uzoq yig'ilishlarda ongim tarqaladi va muhim tafsilotlarni o'tkazib yuboraman.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatni bir joyga jamlay olmaslik, fikrlar boshqa joyga ketib qolishi.

cards.ex: The trip to Disneyland is now just a distant memory.
cards.exUz: Disneylendga sayohat endi faqat uzoq xotira.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p yillar oldin bo'lgan, endi xiralashgan xotira.

cards.ex: Puzzles and brain teasers are a great way to sharpen your mind.
cards.exUz: Boshqotirmalar va aqlni charxlovchi o'yinlar ongni charxlashning ajoyib usuli.
cards.uzDef: Aqliy qobiliyatlarni mashq qilish, o'tkirlash.

cards.ex: She tried to block out the traumatic experience.
cards.exUz: U travmatik tajribani esdan chiqarishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Yoqimsiz, og'riqli xotiralarni ongli ravishda unutishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: She has a good head on her shoulders and always makes wise decisions.
cards.exUz: U aqlli va har doim oqilona qarorlar qabul qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Aqlli, bilimdon, fahmli bo'lish.

cards.ex: I don't like playing mind games in relationships.
cards.exUz: Men munosabatlarda ong o'yinlarini o'ynashni yoqtirmayman.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarni aldash, manipulyatsiya qilish uchun ishlatiladigan usullar.

cards.ex: It completely slipped my mind that we had a meeting today.
cards.exUz: Bugun uchrashuvimiz borligi butunlay esdan chiqib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Eslash kerak bo'lgan narsani unutib qo'ymoq.

cards.ex: The details of the accident are still fresh in my mind.
cards.exUz: Baxtsiz hodisa tafsilotlari hali ham xotiramda yangi.
cards.uzDef: Yaqinda bo'lgan va yaxshi esda qolgan narsa.

cards.ex: I need to do a brain dump to organize my thoughts.
cards.exUz: Fikrlarimni tartibga solish uchun ongimni tozalashim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Barcha fikrlarni, g'oyalarni yozib yoki gapirib tashlash.

cards.ex: Chess requires a lot of mental agility.
cards.exUz: Shaxmat aqliy chaqqonlikni talab qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Tez o'ylash, muammolarni tez hal qilish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: Don't let emotions cloud your judgment.
cards.exUz: Hissiyotlaringiz hukmingizni xiralashtirmasin.
cards.uzDef: Hissiyotlar yoki stress tufayli to'g'ri qaror qabul qila olmaslik.

cards.ex: I said things I didn't mean in the heat of the moment.
cards.exUz: G'azab bilan o'ylab o'tirmasdan, aytmoqchi bo'lmagan narsalarni aytdim.
cards.term: in the heat of the moment
cards.uzDef: Kuchli hissiyotlar ta'sirida, o'ylab o'tirmasdan.

cards.ex: I completely lost my bearings in the unfamiliar city.
cards.exUz: Men notanish shaharda butunlay adashib qoldim.
cards.uzDef: O'z joyingizni yoki vaziyatni anglay olmaslik.

cards.ex: I'm having second thoughts about quitting my job.
cards.exUz: Men ishimni tashlash haqida shubhalanyapman.
cards.uzDef: Qaror qabul qilgandan keyin shubhalanish.

cards.ex: My gut reaction was to say no.
cards.exUz: Mening ichki reaksiyam yo'q deyish edi.
cards.uzDef: Tez, instinktiv javob, o'ylamasdan berilgan reaksiya.

cards.ex: I went for a walk to clear my head.
cards.exUz: Fikrlarimni tozalash uchun sayrga chiqdim.
cards.uzDef: Stressdan xalos bo'lish, dam olish.

cards.ex: The decision isn't set in stone yet.
cards.exUz: Qaror hali qat'iy belgilanmagan.
cards.uzDef: O'zgartirib bo'lmaydigan, qat'iy belgilangan.

cards.ex: She has a sharp mind and is quick to understand new concepts.
cards.exUz: U o'tkir aqlga ega va yangi tushunchalarni tezda tushunadi.
cards.uzDef: Tez va aniq fikrlaydigan aql.

cards.ex: Don't dwell on the past; focus on the future.
cards.exUz: O'tmish haqida o'ylanib qolmang; kelajakka e'tibor qarating.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida uzoq vaqt o'ylash, qayg'urish.

cards.ex: I have a hunch that they're hiding something.
cards.exUz: Ularning nimadir yashirayotganiga sezgim bor.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida aniq dalil bo'lmasa ham, his qilish.

cards.ex: The special effects in that movie were mind-blowing.
cards.exUz: Bu filmdagi maxsus effektlar hayratlanarli edi.
cards.uzDef: Shunchalik ta'sirli, aqlga sig'maydigan.

cards.ex: I have a mental image of my childhood home.
cards.exUz: Mening bolalik uyimning ongdagi tasviri bor.
cards.uzDef: Ongda paydo bo'lgan tasvir, xotira.

cards.ex: I had a total brain fart and forgot her name right when I was introducing her.
cards.exUz: Menda xotira pand berdi va uni tanishtirayotganimda ismini unutib qo'ydim.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmaganda biror narsani eslay olmaslik, ayniqsa noqulay vaziyatda.

cards.ex: I need some time to mull over your proposal before I make a decision.
cards.exUz: Qaror qabul qilishdan oldin sizning taklifingizni chuqur o'ylab ko'rishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida uzoq vaqt davomida chuqur o'ylash.
